payload.core_mechanism_summary: Brute-force over all pairs, trying all orientations and side-by-side/stacked placements, taking max area.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks each pair of seals, similar to enumerating all 2-combinations (a subset of permutations). No pruning or backtracking, so not B&B or backtracking. It's a complete search over all pairs.
